The `_install_font` helper function and all 12 package functions perform only standard font installation: creating font directories, installing `.ttf` files with mode 644, and installing documentation/license files into `/usr/share/doc/` and `/usr/share/licenses/`. A proper SHA-256 checksum is provided (not `SKIP`). There is no obfuscated code, no `eval` or `base64` usage, no execution of downloaded content, no unexpected file operations outside of `$pkgdir`, and no system modifications.
